highlights: Crop nicknames now find the plant. Searching or saying "cantaloupe" returns Charentais, and "cucumber" returns Suyo Long — on whole-garden search, the log picker, the variety picker and voice alike. Previously the nickname only worked in whole-garden search, because the app's own filters never received the alias list.

Log Many: pick exactly the plantings you mean. The selection is sent as an explicit list rather than a rule, with a count check that refuses the batch if fewer plantings resolve than you picked — so a batch can no longer quietly log against a smaller set than the one on screen.
Log Many: filter by location and crop type together — "bag area + tomatoes" narrows to the intersection rather than either one.
Log Many: the review list is now grouped by crop type, matching the picker. Group headers take about 12% of the panel as it opens and up to 35% in the densest stretch; the panel itself is unchanged.

Photos attached only to an inventory item now show as attached. Six photos linked to a seed packet or supply — and nothing else — were reading as having no link at all, because the gallery never fetched that connection.
A photo waiting to be tagged now reads as pending rather than as an error state.
